name: Broken Armor of Ana'thek
summary: The Broken Armor of Ana'thek is a shattered trophy tied to the Skullsplitters of Stranglethorn Vale. Gan'zulah demands it as proof of Ana'thek's defeat.

sections.title: A Chieftain's Demand
sections.body: At Grom'gol Base Camp, Gan'zulah's head commands you to face the Skullsplitters in the eastern mountains. He demands the broken armor of their chief, Ana'thek the Cruel, if you survive the fight.

faq.answer: Ana'thek the Cruel was the chief of the Skullsplitters in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Why does Gan'zulah want the armor?
faq.answer: Gan'zulah demands Ana'thek's shattered armor as proof that you defeated the Skullsplitter chief.

faq.q: Where did the armor come from?
faq.answer: The Broken Armor of Ana'thek comes from Ana'thek the Cruel in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Where do I bring the armor?
faq.answer: Bring the Broken Armor of Ana'thek to the Bubbling Cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp.
